basic_details.job_title: NRLM Karnataka Cluster Supervisor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: NRLM Karnataka has listed 2 Cluster Supervisor (Level L 5) posts for Malur taluka, Kolar district, at a pay of 18000. Applicants must be Graduates with a minimum of 2 years of post qualification relevant experience, aged 18 to 45 years. Applications are taken on the jobsksrlps.karnataka.gov.in portal after signing in, from 27 November 2026 to 12 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Open the Cluster Supervisor (Kolar, Malur) listing on the jobsksrlps.karnataka.gov.in portal.
Sign in to submit the application. A free account can be created first, as the page offers.
Submit the application before the closing date, 12 December 2026.
The notice names no documents to attach and gives no postal address or email address for applications.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Graduate. Experience: minimum 2 years post qualification relevant experience. Language: reading, writing and speaking skills in Kannada and English. Computers: knowledge of working with computers. Age: minimum 18 years and maximum 45 years. The notice does not print a date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Cluster Supervisor Job Description
content_sections.text: The post is at Level L 5. Its stated purpose is to provide overall leadership of the cluster for the development and sustainability of community institutions. The Cluster Supervisor reports directly to the Executive Officer, TP/TPM, and reports to the State Mission Director / CEO-ZP / PD-DRDA / State Program Managers. The duties printed in the notice are: Undertake field visits proactively. Work in close coordination with TMMU / TPM to implement planned activities in the cluster / (sub block). Identify and facilitate the process of organizing and inclusion of women, vulnerable communities (differently abled, SC / STs and other under privileged sections) and strengthening them into functional community level institutions. Facilitate activities relating to livelihoods planning, micro credit meetings, micro credit plan development and CIF utilization among communities. Liaison for service delivery of government entitlement and social safety net schemes in the cluster. Enhance access to entitlements and schemes to community level institutions through convergence. Ensure clean data entered into the MIS at TMMU level in a timely manner. Submit MPRs, QPRs and other relevant reports. Liaison with PRI institutions, line departments and other non – government organizations. Take up any other task as allocated by competent authority at BMMU.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NRLM Karnataka Cluster Supervisor
content_sections.text: Open the Cluster Supervisor (Kolar, Malur) listing on the jobsksrlps.karnataka.gov.in portal. Sign in to submit the application. A free account can be created first, as the page offers. Submit the application before the closing date, 12 December 2026. The notice names no documents to attach and gives no postal address or email address for applications.
